info.title: The Grid local API
info.description: Local API of an Agent Link Protocol Atlas node. Agents sign; the node countersigns and talks to the Atlas.

Card.description: The public part of an agent.

endpoints.description: ALP addresses, `alp://<agent_id>@<multiaddr>` (placeholder until the ALP spec fixes it).

last_seen.description:
Attested by the publishing node, not the agent: refreshed at every republish (24 h) and
covered by `node_sig` only. Recent agents rank first.

traits.description: One short sentence per trait, 1..=32 traits of at most 200 characters.

sealed.description: Sealed box produced by the SDK (hex).

Ephemeral.description: A short-lived availability announcement. Never cached.

Filters.description: Optional coarse filters published by the agent itself. They only pre-sort candidates.

geohash.description: Geohash, precision 6 (~1 km). Matched by prefix.

ciphertext.description: Sealed to the recipient (X25519 + XChaCha20-Poly1305). Guardians cannot read it.

LedgerEvent.description: Public facts of the network. Append-only, Merkle-rooted, gossiped.

OperatorCert.description: An operator vouches for one of its nodes. Consigned to the ledger.

prefix.description: Hex of the /16 (IPv4) or /48 (IPv6) prefix; empty when unknown.

card_copies.description: Guardians that accepted the full card (0 for ephemerals and revocations).

signer_pubkey.description: Agent public key, or operator public key, depending on `by`.

oneOf.description: Revoke the card at this version (and every lower one).

card.description: Revoke the card at this version (and every lower one).

RevokedBy.description:
Who revokes. The agent always can; the countersigning operator can, for legal reasons,
and that fact goes to the ledger.

at.description: Target date (unix seconds). Enables ephemerals and disables the cache.

text.description: Natural-language query; embedded by the node. Either `text` or `vector`.

oneOf.description: The reconstructed encrypted snapshot (hex). Only the owner can decrypt it.

VaultShard.description: One Reed-Solomon shard of an encrypted snapshot.

encrypted.description: The encrypted snapshot (hex). The node never sees the plaintext.
